name: value-utilities/aspect-grow-origin
description: Static + value entries surfaced by smoke testing on a real Tailwind v3 dashboard. `aspect-{auto,square,video}` from upstream's `aspectRatio` plugin (named statics — the numeric scale isn't in the default theme). `flex-grow` / `flex-shrink` legacy aliases for `grow` / `shrink` (upstream registers both names). `origin-{center,top,top-right,…}` named keywords from `transformOrigin`, plus the arbitrary `origin-[<value>]` form via the value-utility table.
